# Preserve semantically equivalent vanilla privileges from old saves.
# If both versions were serialized, remove only the JXP duplicate and
# bridge its lost loyalty equilibrium once per privilege per five years.
jxp_a_clear_legacy_duplicate_japanese_estate_privileges_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_estate_privilege = estate_nobles_land_rights has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_nobles_chigyo_confirmation }
		remove_estate_privilege = jxp_a_nobles_chigyo_confirmation
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_estate = estate_nobles
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_nobles_chigyo_confirmation_transition_recent }
					had_country_flag = { flag = jxp_a_nobles_chigyo_confirmation_transition_recent days = 1825 }
				}
			}
			add_estate_loyalty_modifier = { estate = estate_nobles desc = jxp_a_estate_val_privilege_transition loyalty = 5 duration = 1825 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_nobles_chigyo_confirmation_transition_recent
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_nobles_chigyo_confirmation_transition_recent
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_estate_privilege = estate_nobles_levies has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_nobles_war_levy_assessment }
		remove_estate_privilege = jxp_a_nobles_war_levy_assessment
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_estate = estate_nobles
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_nobles_war_levy_assessment_transition_recent }
					had_country_flag = { flag = jxp_a_nobles_war_levy_assessment_transition_recent days = 1825 }
				}
			}
			add_estate_loyalty_modifier = { estate = estate_nobles desc = jxp_a_estate_val_privilege_transition loyalty = 5 duration = 1825 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_nobles_war_levy_assessment_transition_recent
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_nobles_war_levy_assessment_transition_recent
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_estate_privilege = estate_nobles_right_of_counsel has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_nobles_house_council_seats }
		remove_estate_privilege = jxp_a_nobles_house_council_seats
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_estate = estate_nobles
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_nobles_house_council_seats_transition_recent }
					had_country_flag = { flag = jxp_a_nobles_house_council_seats_transition_recent days = 1825 }
				}
			}
			add_estate_loyalty_modifier = { estate = estate_nobles desc = jxp_a_estate_val_privilege_transition loyalty = 5 duration = 1825 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_nobles_house_council_seats_transition_recent
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_nobles_house_council_seats_transition_recent
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_estate_privilege = estate_church_land_rights has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_church_temple_land_confirmation }
		remove_estate_privilege = jxp_a_church_temple_land_confirmation
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_estate = estate_church
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_church_temple_land_confirmation_transition_recent }
					had_country_flag = { flag = jxp_a_church_temple_land_confirmation_transition_recent days = 1825 }
				}
			}
			add_estate_loyalty_modifier = { estate = estate_church desc = jxp_a_estate_val_privilege_transition loyalty = 5 duration = 1825 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_church_temple_land_confirmation_transition_recent

# One-shot transactional schema migration.  The flag is committed only
# after every legacy/JXP duplicate has actually disappeared; interrupted
# startup reconciliation therefore retries without duplicating rewards.
jxp_a_migrate_legacy_estate_privileges_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_estate_privilege_migration_v2 } }
		jxp_a_clear_legacy_duplicate_japanese_estate_privileges_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { OR = { AND = { has_estate_privilege = estate_nobles_land_rights has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_nobles_chigyo_confirmation } AND = { has_estate_privilege = estate_nobles_levies has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_nobles_war_levy_assessment } AND = { has_estate_privilege = estate_nobles_right_of_counsel has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_nobles_house_council_seats } AND = { has_estate_privilege = estate_church_land_rights has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_church_temple_land_confirmation } AND = { has_estate_privilege = estate_burghers_land_rights has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_burghers_town_council_autonomy } } } }
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_estate_privilege_migration_v2
		}
	}
}

				}
			}
			add_estate_loyalty_modifier = { estate = estate_burghers desc = jxp_a_estate_val_privilege_transition loyalty = 5 duration = 1825 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_burghers_warehouse_rice_notes_transition_recent
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_burghers_warehouse_rice_notes_transition_recent
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_burghers_red_seal_trade NOT = { AND = { jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes jxp_oceanic_opening_at_least_50 = yes } } }
		remove_estate_privilege = jxp_a_burghers_red_seal_trade
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_estate = estate_burghers
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_burghers_red_seal_trade_transition_recent }
					had_country_flag = { flag = jxp_a_burghers_red_seal_trade_transition_recent days = 1825 }
				}
			}
			add_estate_loyalty_modifier = { estate = estate_burghers desc = jxp_a_estate_val_privilege_transition loyalty = 5 duration = 1825 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_burghers_red_seal_trade_transition_recent
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_burghers_red_seal_trade_transition_recent
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_burghers_company_incorporation NOT = { AND = { jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes OR = { has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_3 has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_4 } } } }
		remove_estate_privilege = jxp_a_burghers_company_incorporation
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_estate = estate_burghers
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_burghers_company_incorporation_transition_recent }
					had_country_flag = { flag = jxp_a_burghers_company_incorporation_transition_recent days = 1825 }
				}
			}
			add_estate_loyalty_modifier = { estate = estate_burghers desc = jxp_a_estate_val_privilege_transition loyalty = 5 duration = 1825 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_burghers_company_incorporation_transition_recent
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_burghers_company_incorporation_transition_recent
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_burghers_public_bond_subscription NOT = { AND = { jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_public_credit_ready } } }
		remove_estate_privilege = jxp_a_burghers_public_bond_subscription
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_estate = estate_burghers
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_burghers_public_bond_subscription_transition_recent }
					had_country_flag = { flag = jxp_a_burghers_public_bond_subscription_transition_recent days = 1825 }
				}
			}
			add_estate_loyalty_modifier = { estate = estate_burghers desc = jxp_a_estate_val_privilege_transition loyalty = 5 duration = 1825 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_burghers_public_bond_subscription_transition_recent
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_burghers_public_bond_subscription_transition_recent
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_villages_rural_industry NOT = { AND = { jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes OR = { has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_2 has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_3 has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_4 } } } }
		remove_estate_privilege = jxp_a_villages_rural_industry
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_estate = jxp_estate_village_communes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_villages_rural_industry_transition_recent }
					had_country_flag = { flag = jxp_a_villages_rural_industry_transition_recent days = 1825 }
				}
			}
			add_estate_loyalty_modifier = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes desc = jxp_a_estate_val_privilege_transition loyalty = 5 duration = 1825 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_villages_rural_industry_transition_recent
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_villages_rural_industry_transition_recent
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_villages_common_workshops NOT = { AND = { jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes OR = { has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_3 has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_4 } } } }
		remove_estate_privilege = jxp_a_villages_common_workshops
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_estate = jxp_estate_village_communes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_villages_common_workshops_transition_recent }
					had_country_flag = { flag = jxp_a_villages_common_workshops_transition_recent days = 1825 }
				}
			}
			add_estate_loyalty_modifier = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes desc = jxp_a_estate_val_privilege_transition loyalty = 5 duration = 1825 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_villages_common_workshops_transition_recent
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_villages_common_workshops_transition_recent
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_villages_overseas_service_exemption NOT = { AND = { jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes has_country_flag = jxp_iface_overseas_charter_ready } } }
		remove_estate_privilege = jxp_a_villages_overseas_service_exemption
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_estate = jxp_estate_village_communes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_villages_overseas_service_exemption_transition_recent }
					had_country_flag = { flag = jxp_a_villages_overseas_service_exemption_transition_recent days = 1825 }
				}
			}
			add_estate_loyalty_modifier = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes desc = jxp_a_estate_val_privilege_transition loyalty = 5 duration = 1825 }
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_villages_overseas_service_exemption_transition_recent
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_villages_overseas_service_exemption_transition_recent
		}
	}
}

jxp_a_reconcile_japanese_estates_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes }
		jxp_a_migrate_legacy_estate_privileges_effect = yes
		jxp_a_clear_illegal_japanese_estate_privileges_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_estates_ready
	}
	else = { jxp_a_clear_japanese_estates_effect = yes }
}

# Public route-transition alias required by the socioeconomic contract.
# The delegated reconcile is itself idempotent and owns all cleanup.
jxp_a_reconcile_estates_for_route = {
	jxp_a_reconcile_japanese_estates_effect = yes
}
